translations.web: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.
translations.bsb: You know when I sit and when I rise; You understand my thoughts from afar.
translations.kjv: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.
translations.asv: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising; Thou understandest my thought afar off.
